Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts:45

Static catalog entry — everything the scene needs to place a body, declared once per body in catalog.ts. Orbiting bodies set orbit + parent; fixed deep-sky objects set pos directly.

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts:73

Orbital eccentricity 0–1 — when set, the pivot still sweeps the angle uniformly but the mesh's radial distance follows the conic r = a(1−e²)/(1+e·cos θ) so the body draws a visible ellipse (Halley-type comets) instead of the default circle. orbit reads as the semi-major axis and phase as the periapsis longitude.

rim?

optional rim?: number;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts:86

Limb tint override (SF_COLORS hex) — the fresnel mixes toward this at the silhouette instead of the default hot STAR_RIM. A darker rim produces limb darkening on resolved star discs (the Sun): we see deeper hotter layers at centre, cooler gas at the limb.

activity?

optional activity?: number;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts:92

Corona activity scale (1 = quiet star) — stretches prominences, adds eruption plumes and sunspots, and enlarges the corona sprite. The Sun runs above 1 so its surface reads as an active photosphere.

spiralDisc?

optional spiralDisc?: object;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts:123

Procedural spiral galaxy — render the seeded Points disc instead of a flat sprite. count is the star-particle target (capped by SF_SPIRAL.COUNT_MAX, divided on mobile) standing in for the galaxy's true stellar population; arms overrides the arm count. volumetric drops the photographic quad entirely (the Milky Way is viewed from inside — a face-on photo is geometrically false) and thickens the particle disc; elliptical fills a smooth spheroid for dwarf-spheroidal members that have no spiral structure.

Small-body annulus (asteroid/Kuiper belt) — inner/outer are the ring bounds in chart units, count the particle budget, puff the vertical half-thickness multiplier on def.radius. The def's radius doubles as the camera-framing value on fly-to; the def's color tints the particles. gapFreq overrides the Kirkwood-lane modulation frequency (0 = smooth disc, no resonance gaps).

weather?

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts:186

Procedural weather — replaces the static cloudTexture deck with the full weather.ts field: evolving coverage, jet streams, ITCZ monsoon band, hurricane vortices, seasonal snow lines, volcanic ash plumes and matching surface cloud shadows (Earth).

aurora?

optional aurora?:
  | boolean
  | {
  color?: number;
  colorLow?: number;
  tilt?: number;
  lat?: number;
  intensity?: number;
  south?: boolean;
};

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts:199

Aurora shell — a thin rayed emission OVAL centered on the magnetic pole (not the spin pole), driven by the shared solar-wind uniform so solar storms light every aurora-bearing body at once (Earth, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune). Pass true for the default Earth-green oxygen palette, or a config object for per-body physics: color/colorLow are the curtain-top/lower-edge emissions, tilt the magnetic dipole's offset from the spin axis (radians — Neptune's is ~0.82 rad ≈ 47°), lat the oval's |lat| center and intensity a brightness multiplier (Jupiter > Earth > Saturn > Neptune, matching real emitted power).

Meteor strikes — airless cratered bodies still take impacts; a pooled flash sprite fires at a random surface point every SF_METEOR.INTERVAL-ish seconds (updateFx). For bodies whose dossier describes ongoing bombardment — the flash makes the crater record readable as a live process.
